paragraphs: Rav Yehudah bar Ishteta brought a basket of fruit to Rav Natan son of R. Oshaya, etc. According to whom? Rav Yosef: Eruvin 52a, near the end. Rashi explains Ishteta as a person's name; see there. Rif has Rav Yehudah of Bartota.
